whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Krishnashree,

I noticed your store has solid 3.9★ reviews with over 500 happy customers in Kadamkuan, but lacked a dedicated mobile website for local catalog inquiries.

Maine aapke business ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp product inquiry, collection showcase, aur store location integrate ki hai:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/krishnashree

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Team Krishnashree, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke business ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? Great! We tailored it specifically with mobile-first speed and direct WhatsApp product inquiries for your Kadamkuan store. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko design direction pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact product categories aur contact setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
